prompt: Prepare a short Simplified Chinese assessment for the Aster Archive Network funding board. Use the brief and saved research packet only. Return bare JSON with report (your three numbered paragraphs), current_coverage (object: census_source, active_branches, eligible_branches, baseline_source), sorting (object keyed by source ID for the two records behind the brief's 140-machine figure, each with count and status), and night_shift (object: outcome and excluded, with excluded mapping each look-alike record ID to one reason; do not include housekeeping records). Use the codes in desk-card.md. Source names can go inline in the report.
terse: Build an evidence map for the assessment before drafting. For each important claim, connect what the source measures to the operational implication and state what the evidence cannot establish.

notes.coverage-window-and-scope: SKILL.md procedure 2, Set the recency boundary before searching. An older final census outranks the current provisional file in the saved search but is usable only as a baseline; a newer branch anecdote and a source-free generated estimate cannot replace the in-window network denominator. Trap answer uses B04 for current coverage.
notes.status-and-denominator: SKILL.md procedures 3, 5 and 7; references/claim-audit.md, Evidence-status ladder. The supplied 140 combines units allowed under an executed contract with demonstration passes on a counter, not machines in service. Trap answer treats both counts as delivered units.
notes.auditable-negative: SKILL.md Negative findings and evidence backfill. Return a bounded negative with an item-level exclusion ledger, including a bibliographic hit whose inaccessible full text cannot establish its findings. Trap answer promotes that lead to a qualifying case and omits its exclusion.
